title: Wallpaper prompt tour with lens wipes and monitor close
summary: A one-word mark types over flower footage, a ring opens onto a desktop wallpaper where a prompt is typed and sent, then a desk with a capability scroll, a glass-lens headline over autumn footage and a monitor end card.
use_when: An AI assistant or productivity tool that wants a friendly, nostalgic look instead of dark UI
Showing one prompt being asked, then many things the tool covers
A 30 s social cut that ends on a URL and a logo on a device
Brands with a mascot or small mark that can sit alone on screen

look.type_style: rounded geometric sans, bold, sentence case, white on footage at ~7 % H for headlines; caps label for the name; dark on white at ~4 % H on the monitor

sfx.event: letters typing (name, prompt, headline, monitor lines)
action pill swaps and mark tile

structure.shot: macro footage of two orange tulips against a blue sky, filling the frame
structure.camera: pull-out: scale ~1.25->1.00 over 30 fr, decelerating (motion.json zoom -20 to -28 %/s)
structure.motion: footage only; pull-out on easings.outQuint ~30 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: same tulip footage wider; product name types in white caps at centre, four small dots sit around it
structure.motion: name types letter by letter, 1.00->1.50 (~15 fr, ±0.25 s); four satellite dots fade in at 1.50 around the word (top, left, right, bottom)

structure.shot: name deletes back to a caret, a one-word category label types in smaller, holds, then deletes to a single dot
structure.motion: delete 2.27->2.50, category word types 2.50->2.77 (±0.25 s), holds to 3.50, deletes by 3.77, one dot left; dots tighten to the shorter word

structure.shot: a thin circular ring opens over the flowers and reveals a classic green-hill desktop wallpaper; a dark prompt bar with a small mascot icon and a question heading settles centre
structure.camera: zoom 0.6 s through the ring (cuts.json soft 4.23-4.83), then hold
structure.motion: circle iris mask grows from centre, ~18 fr (frame 127->145); old scene fades under it; prompt bar fades and rises in by 4.77 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the prompt bar holds while a short question (6 words) types in with a caret
structure.camera: push-in ~1.00->1.25 at 5.77 on springs.cameraIn ~15 fr (±0.25 s), then slow lateral drift left ~-76 to -127 px/s @1920
structure.motion: typewriter ~4 chars per 0.25 s cell, caret blinks; frame shows slight jitter (handheld-like, unmeasured)

structure.shot: camera flies up and right to the send button at the bar's right end; the bar slides away, leaving sky; a blue circle rises from the bottom edge
structure.camera: push-in to element tier at 8.27 (~1.6x, ±0.25 s), then fast pan up-right ending in a motion burst at 9.0-9.5
structure.motion: send button click implied at ~8.77 (not seen at 4 fps); bar exits left by 9.27 on easings.inExpo (±0.25 s); blue circle enters from bottom 9.50

structure.shot: top-down photo of a wooden desk with three sketch sheets, colour fan, pen and camera; the blue circle with an up arrow rises and leaves
structure.camera: pull-out from the centre sheet 10.27->11.50, ~1.6->1.00 (±0.25 s), with an upward pan 10.0-11.0 (-625 px/s @1920)
structure.motion: blue send circle travels upward and out of frame 10.00->10.27 on easings.inExpo (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a centred vertical list of about 12 capability names scrolls upward over the desk; one item near the bottom reads bright, the rest dimmed
structure.motion: list rolls up at constant speed ~2 rows per 0.25 s (easings.linear, ±0.25 s); far rows fade by distance; scroll stops 14.77 with one bright item centred, others fade out by 15.00

structure.shot: the remaining word becomes a soft glass pill button with a one-word action label; an arrow cursor arrives and presses it
structure.motion: word fades to pill 15.50->15.77 (±0.25 s); cursor enters lower right 16.00, glides to the pill by 16.27, press at ~16.50 on springs.click (squash not measurable)

structure.shot: white flash washes over the desk scene
structure.motion: white flash peaks ~4 fr (frames 500-504, cuts.json flash), then holds white

structure.shot: flat white frame with a small pale glass bubble at centre
structure.motion: glass bubble sits centred, ~10 % of frame width

structure.shot: the bubble grows into a full-frame glass lens rim over autumn-avenue footage; a headline start (4 words) types left, a pill on the right cycles 4 action labels
structure.camera: lens zoom 0.37 s (cuts.json soft 17.17-17.53), then static
structure.motion: lens grows ~11 fr (frames 515->526) on easings.outExpo; headline types 17.50->18.00; pill label swaps every ~1.1-1.3 s (18.50, 19.77, 20.77) by blur crossfade upward, ~7 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the pill dissolves and the headline's last words drop in, completing one 8-word line
structure.motion: closing words slide down into line with a blur, ~7 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: fade to white; a white desktop monitor rises from below to centre; two lines type on its screen: an invitation and the URL
structure.camera: monitor rises 23.27->23.50 on springs.heavy (overshoot not measurable), then static
structure.motion: white wash 10 fr (frames 672->682); lines type 23.50->24.00 (±0.25 s), hold 1.0 s, cleared by 25.27

structure.shot: the monitor screen shows only the small mascot mark tile at centre
structure.motion: mark tile cuts in at 25.27; tiny eye change at 25.77 (blink, ±0.25 s); jumps down 0.5 frame-height at 26.00 (layout shift)

structure.shot: the screen shows a closing slogan of two 2-word sentences typing in
structure.motion: first sentence appears 26.77, second types 27.27->27.50 (±0.25 s), line recentres on springs.ui; hold to 28.00

structure.shot: push in on the monitor; the letter mark appears, then the wordmark types beside it and holds to the end
structure.camera: push-in 1.00->~1.20 from 28.00 to 28.50 on springs.cameraIn (±0.25 s), then slow creep (+1.9 %/s)
structure.motion: mark cuts in at 28.27; drifts off-centre 29.00; wordmark types 29.50->29.77 while the pair recentres on springs.ui; hold 1.1 s

params.brand: brand.json: display font, fg, accent (send button and circle), bg, logo mark and wordmark
params.content.name: product name typed at the open, one word
params.content.category: one word that replaces the name (what the product is)
params.content.question: prompt-bar heading, a question of about 6 words
params.content.prompt: text typed into the bar, about 6 words
params.content.capabilities: 10-14 short capability names for the scrolling list; one is held at the end
params.content.action: one-word label on the pill button the cursor presses
params.content.headline: 8-word line split into a 4-word start and a 4-word close
params.content.actions: 4 short action labels cycled in the pill (3-4 words each)
params.content.cta: two monitor lines: invitation and URL
params.footage: 5 backgrounds: flower macro, desktop wallpaper, top-down desk, autumn avenue, white studio with a monitor

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s) and cuts.json; motion.json gives the zoom/pan rates. Music only, no VO: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. cut_on_beat 0/6 (hard and soft cut starts all > 2 fr from a beat). The 16.67 cut is a white flash (cuts.json via flash, same composition). Spring names and the 4 orbit dots' motion are suggestions (not measurable at 4 fps). Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): iris-lens (ring that grows into a refracting lens over the next scene, rows 4 and 12), dot-satellites (four dots ringing a word, rows 2-3), device-monitor (desktop monitor frame, rows 14-17). Theme light: majority bright backgrounds, no dark section.
